jobs.title: Spatial Analyst
jobs.description:
Accent Environmental is a Melbourne-based environmental consultancy of specialists working on environmental impact assessments, landscape and visual impact assessments, and approvals for renewables, mining and other major projects across Australia and internationally. Accent places a strong emphasis on clear visual communication to complement and enhance our high quality written reports.

We're looking for a Spatial Analyst to join our team and help deliver spatial analysis, GIS and visual communication across our project work - producing the spatial and visual information and figures that go into our technical reports and building your skills across a range of different projects and sectors. You'll work closely with our Lead Spatial Analyst, who is focused on the high quality delivery of our spatial work and the expansion of our capabilities. You'll be part of an evolving practice, picking up and helping develop new tools, methods and analytical approaches.

What you'll be doing
Sourcing and quality-checking spatial data across our projects - satellite imagery, cadastral data, environmental datasets, and client-supplied files
Producing maps, figures, and spatial analysis for environmental and social impact assessments, landscape and visual impact assessments, including in the renewables and mining sectors
Assisting with spatial modelling and analysis - constraints mapping, viewshed and visual impact analysis, site suitability
Helping build and maintain our GIS workflows, spatial databases, and mapping templates
Supporting both senior and junior staff as they build their GIS knowledge and skills
Contributing spatial input to proposals and tenders

What we're after
Bachelor degree in geographic information systems, spatial science, geography, environmental science, or related discipline
2-5 years' experience in GIS/spatial analysis, ideally within environmental consulting, planning, or a related field
Solid QGIS and/or ArcGIS skills, and a good grasp of geospatial principles and cartographic design
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain spatial findings to non-technical audiences
Detail-oriented, with excellent time management and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
Desirable – exposure to spatial databases (e.g. PostGIS) and scripting/automation for GIS workflows (e.g. Python, ModelBuilder)
Desirable – experience producing spatial outputs for EIA, LCVIA, BESS, or renewable energy planning projects
Desirable – experience with remote sensing analysis, drone-captured data, 3D visualisation (e.g. Blender), and Adobe Creative Suite
Awareness of potential AI developments and opportunities within the spatial and visual communication fields
Current Victorian driver's licence

If this sounds like your kind of role, we'd like to hear from you. Send your CV and a short cover letter to HR @accentenvironmental.com.au
telling us about a spatial project you're proud of.

Accent Environmental is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunity and invites applicants from all nationalities, genders, and cultural backgrounds.

Leads management activities by overseeing technical tasks, schedules, budgets, and deliverables to ensure successful completion of assigned projects. Manages various aspects of project execution, including client communication, team coordination, and quality assurance. Responsible for preparation of design reports and plans that make up elements of design deliverable packages.

Engages with clients and stakeholders to communicate project goals, progress, and outcomes. Builds and maintains relationships to support business development and client satisfaction.
Mentors junior staff by providing technical guidance, training, reviewing work products, and fostering professional growth. Encourages knowledge sharing and collaboration within the team.
Follows applicable federal, Tribal, state, local, industry, contractual, and company regulations, standards, and specifications.
Performs related work as assigned.

Develop construction plans within AutoCAD Civil 3D. Typically restoration plans but occasional site civil support may be required.
Perform hydraulic, hydrologic, and water quality assessments, modeling, and analysis in support of the above listed projects.
Communicate and work with project managers to keep projects on schedule and on budget.

Work independently and multi-task regularly in a fast-paced environment; work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Four years of relevant, progressively responsible experience. Six years of related experience is preferred; or any equivalent combination of experience, performance, training, and/or education. Knowledge normally obtained through a bachelor's degree and active Professional Engineer (PE) license required.

Experience And Qualifications For Success

EI certification (Engineering Intern)
Ability to travel on short-term overnight efforts to collect field data and meet with clients, up to 25% of the time.
Experience with HEC-RAS and other hydraulic and hydrologic modeling and analysis software.
Experience developing ecological restoration design construction plans in AutoCAD Civil 3D.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing primary tasks and small to medium sized projects with limited oversight.
Experience mentoring and successfully delegating tasks to junior team members.

In addition, this Senior Project Manager will serve a key support role for the assessment and mitigation of environmental risk in transactions – including mergers & acquisitions, real estate and restructuring activities – and strategic initiatives. This Senior Project Manager will work closely with team members from Environmental & Properties Risk, real estate, sourcing, special projects, strategy, finance, legal, EHS, governmental affairs, communications, operations, and facilities to provide technical leadership and coordination.

Strong attention to detail.
Excellent communication and presentation (oral/written) skills; public presentations both in person and virtual are an essential part of job function.
Demonstrated collaboration skills within diverse teams.
Ability to clearly communicate complex technical information in an easy-to-understand manner.
Demonstrated success in coordinating technical, financial, reputational and legal considerations for complex projects.
Strong technical and analytical aptitude to understand and articulate complicated trade-offs.
Experience working with sensitive and confidential information.
Experience working cross-culturally in large, matrixed organizations and ability to navigate geographies, cultures, relationships, etc.
Ability and willingness to travel including internationally (~30% travel).
Proficiency with MS Office Programs including Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
English proficiency and a minimum of business fluency in at least one of the following languages: Spanish or Portuguese.

Qualifications That Will Make You Stand Out

Graduate degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, biology, chemistry, business or relevant related discipline.
Highly collaborative person with outstanding communication skills.
Strategic and flexible thinker who uses a 360 degree perspective to assess risks.

Ability to see big picture while not losing sight of critical details.
Ability to be flexible, follow tight deadlines, and deliver results quickly.
Ability to multi-task and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Demonstrated project management skills including project initiation, scoping, resorting, scheduling, budgeting, risk management and communication.
Great energy and enthusiasm for position and environmental risk management.
Fluency or familiarity with additional prominent language(s) such as Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Mandarin, or Vietnamese.
